What is BioEdge™ and how does it work?

BioEdge™ is an advanced skincare product formulated with natural ingredients that firms, hydrates, and rejuvenates the skin. The blend of cold-pressed oils penetrates deep into the skin, increasing elasticity and restoring its natural radiance.

How quickly will I see results?

Many users notice a clear improvement in skin firmness and hydration within 24 hours, while regular use ensures even better and long-lasting results.

Is BioEdge™ suitable for all skin types?

Yes, it is developed to work effectively on all skin types, including sensitive skin.

All your questions answered

How quickly will people notice that I've used it?

Most people notice smoother skin under the eyes and reduced puffiness already within 5 minutes after application! With continued use, fine lines fade and the skin tone becomes noticeably clearer within 7–10 days. Expect immediate relief and continuous improvement!

Does it work even if my eye bags are really severe or have been around for a long time?

Yes! BioEdge™ is specifically developed for deep, long-lasting puffiness and under-eye bags that have been around for a long time. Even users who have struggled for years saw results in just minutes, with a full transformation within 1 to 2 weeks.

Is it safe for sensitive skin or people with allergies?

Absolutely! BioEdge™ is free from fragrance and parabens, and contains gentle ingredients like squalane and hyaluronic acid. It is tested and approved for daily use, even on sensitive and reactive skin.

How do I return the product and get my money back?

Not satisfied? No worries! Just send an email to our customer service at info@thebioedge.co and we will help you immediately. You benefit from our hassle-free 30-day money back guarantee.

Can I use it with makeup or other skincare products?

Yes! BioEdge™ works perfectly under makeup and fits seamlessly into your routine. Simply apply to clean skin first, let it absorb for a few minutes, and then continue with your usual products.
